model.param_value: 30,134 params · 172 KB ONNX (opset 17)  + wake ONNX, shared 80-mel
model.note: Fixed-window KWS classifier: TWO ONNX models (wake + command/slot) share ONE 80-mel / 3.0 s feature on the Pi. It is NOT a streaming / KV-cache encoder — the template's 'causal encoder · KV-cache · streaming' box is replaced by the actual BC-ResNet window model.
